'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Daniel Lane LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Daniel Lane]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
